text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 10, "unit": "books", "kind": "count", "span": "each of the middle 2 shelves can hold 10 books"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 5, "unit": "books", "kind": "count", "span": "the top shelf can hold 5 fewer books than the bottom shelf"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 110, "unit": "books", "kind": "count", "span": "she has 110 books"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q1"], "out": "s1", "note": "the two middle shelves together"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q1", "q1"], "out": "s2", "note": "the bottom shelf, which holds twice as many as a middle shelf"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s2", "q2"], "out": "s3", "note": "the top shelf, five fewer than the bottom"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s4", "note": "middle shelves plus bottom shelf"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s4", "s3"], "out": "s5", "note": "the capacity of one whole bookcase"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q3", "s5"], "out": "s6", "note": "books to store divided by the capacity of one bookcase"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "the number of bookcases Elly needs to hold all her books"}, "dismissed": [{"value": 2, "reason": "the '2' of 'the middle 2 shelves' and the 'twice' relation are both expressed by adding a middle shelf's capacity to itself"}]}
